design_philosophy: Elegant & minimal, leaning into warm southern elegance. Awwwards-worthy art direction with generous whitespace, refined typography, and premium motion. Avoid generic minimalism; embrace atmosphere through subtle grain, rich textures, and editorial layouts.

fonts.usage: Headings, Logo fallback, Marquee, primary display text
Body text, small caps labels, secondary copy

typography.guidelines: Use tight tracking on large serif headings (tracking-tighter). Body text should be airy with loose line-height (leading-relaxed). Labels use uppercase with wide letter-spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

colors.guidelines: Avoid pure black and pure white. Base is a warm cream/ivory. Secondary sections use a deep forest green. Accents use a soft muted gold/terracotta. Contrast is paramount for readability.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise/grain overlay across the entire page (opacity 2-4% maximum) to give a tactile, print-like feel.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Avoid heavy drop shadows or glassmorphism. Use flat surfaces with generous negative space. If a border is needed, use 1px solid with 10% opacity.
visual_enhancers.parallax: Subtle image parallax on scroll, never exceeding 15% translation difference from the scroll speed.

layouts.hero: Centered, high-impact. A refined typographic logo ('The Sweet Magnolia' in Cormorant Garamond italic/regular mix) sitting centrally. Below it, a line-by-line kinetic reveal of the intro text using Framer Motion.
layouts.spacing: Exaggerated vertical rhythm. Use py-24 to py-40 between sections.
layouts.alignment: Hero is centered as requested, but subsequent sections should introduce subtle asymmetry to create visual tension (e.g., text block offset to a 4-column span in a 12-column grid).

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling is MANDATORY. This dictates the premium feel of the page.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion line-by-line masking (kinetic typography) for the hero intro. Staggered fade-up for secondary text.
motion.marquee: Ultra-slow editorial drift (using framer-motion or react-fast-marquee) for the 'Beautiful stays. Thoughtful homes. Seamless living.' text. Avoid fast, cheap ticker effects.

image_urls.description: Warm, elegant boutique hotel interior living space with wooden floors. Can be used as a heavily masked/opacity-reduced parallax backdrop.
Close up white magnolia flower. Great for a subtle offset image next to the manifesto paragraph.

marquee.text: Beautiful stays. Thoughtful homes. Seamless living.

manifesto.text: Whether you're booking a getaway or calling one of our properties home, The Sweet Magnolia brings comfort, thoughtful hospitality, and effortless rental management together in one place.

coming_soon.notice: Direct Booking & Resident Portal — Coming Soon

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure `lenis` is installed and wrapped around the main layout for smooth scrolling.
Use `framer-motion` for kinetic text reveals. Create a mask wrapper (overflow-hidden) around each line of the hero text and animate the text's Y transform from 100% to 0%.
Construct a custom pure CSS noise overlay class (pointer-events-none, fixed, inset-0, mix-blend-multiply) and apply it to the main container.
For the logo, since an image isn't provided, create a beautiful text-based lockup using Cormorant Garamond, varying weights or italics for an editorial look.
Never use `transition: all`. Define specific transition properties.
Do not center-align the manifesto paragraph; give it an offset left margin or place it in a restricted column (e.g., max-w-2xl) to break the symmetry.
All interactive elements must include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid="coming-soon-notice"`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use custom HTML/Tailwind over basic components for this marketing landing page.
No default blue links or generic buttons. Maintain the color archetype strictly.
Create depth through typography scale (very large display sizes vs tiny uppercase tracking labels) rather than shadows.
Ensure the hero overlay on images (if used) is no darker than bg-black/40. If using a light theme, use bg-[#F7F5F0]/80 for readability while letting the image breathe.
